capabilities: Save a single article from a pasted URL
Fetch account history or album directories
Keep indexes and resume partial selections
extras: Interface is currently in Chinese; Linux and mobile are not supported; Mac WeChat 4.x history discovery is experimental.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive WeChat public-account articles and their images as local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: End users do not need Python, Node.js, Docker, AI, an MCP server, wechatDownload, or WeChat Read.

summary: Archiver that saves WeChat Official Account articles, account history, and albums as Markdown notes with local images.
